title: GitHub Pages workflow: publish the site on each release

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Feature: GitHub Pages workflow publishes the site on each release

Scenario: A tagged release triggers a deploy without a manual step
  Given a Semantic Release tag cut on main with scored studies/ committed
  When the release workflow runs on that tag
  Then it builds the static site and publishes it to GitHub Pages automatically, with no manual deploy step

right_now_summary: The workflow now builds and publishes the site to GitHub Pages whenever a release tag is created.
